## ❓ Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. 

> *Ex. "I'm always frustrated when trying to parse custom log formats because the collector doesn't support..." or "Managing multi-container alerts requires manually reviewing..."*

---

## 🎯 Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Describe the feature, CLI flag, API endpoint, or workflow behavior you would like added to Security Sentinel.

---

## 🛠️ Target Category
Which area of Security Sentinel does this request impact?

- [ ] Security Rules / Detection Logic
- [ ] Agent & Log Collector
- [ ] Backend Service & API
- [ ] Frontend / Web Dashboard
- [ ] Docker / Deployment Infrastructure
- [ ] CI/CD & GitHub Actions Workflows

---

## 🔄 Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions, temporary workarounds, or scripts you've considered or implemented.

---

## 🔍 Additional Context
Add any other context, architectural diagrams, mockup screenshots, or sample log structures related to the feature request here.
